text:
anya: Quick flag  exploring a hover/keyboard preview for the roles grid in the invite drawer. Idea: hover/focus a role row and show a small anchored preview (no click). Keeps grid dense but gives instant perms view. Figma: https://figma.redwood/hover-preview :link

devon: Love instant preview. Q: how does this work on touch? Suggest: on touch, tap = select, long-press = preview or show a tiny caret to open preview.

rui: Accessibility: must support keyboard focus updating the preview. Use `aria-controls` from the row to the preview region and `aria-live=polite` with text like "Preview: Viewer role, read only". Arrow keys to move between rows, Enter/Space to open persistent panel. For touch, long-press is fine but also ensure there's a persistent chevron for discoverability.

sarah: Copy for preview header: "Viewer 1 permissions" (or "Editor 1 permissions"). Teaser line in grid: "Viewer  read-only". Preview body: short bullets: "View projects", "View logs & audits", "Cannot invite". CTA in preview: "Assign". If SSO implication exists show small warning: "SSO required to assign".

ken: Telemetry: `roles.preview_shown`, `roles.preview_persisted`, `roles.preview_touch_longpress`, `invite.assign_from_preview`. Also track preview impressions vs assign conversions.

maya: Mobile behavior: prefer a sticky bottom mini-preview that appears when row focused or tapped. Ensure it doesn't cover the primary CTAs. Also in overflow list show an explicit "Preview" affordance for screen readers.

rui: On SSO enforcement: when org SSO is ON, annotate roles that require SSO with lock icon + `aria-describedby` linking to explanatory text. If toggling enforcement OFF require typed confirm: "Type your org name to confirm disabling SSO enforcement". For enabling enforcement we should show a checklist modal listing affected accounts and a confirm button. Both modals must trap focus and announce with `aria-modal=true`.

anya: UX trade: anchored preview is low-friction but may occlude nearby rows. Maybe preview should prefer to render to the right on desktop and bottom on small widths. Add a smart placement rule.

devon: Placement wise: right-first, if not enough space flip to bottom. For anchored previews, add a subtle drop shadow and small pointer to origin row. Keep previews under 320px wide.

sarah: Copy tweak for SSO confirm disable modal: "Disabling SSO enforcement may allow users to sign in without your identity provider. To confirm, type your org name: <org-name>" CTA: "Disable enforcement" / "Cancel". Legal prefers "may".

ken: Add audit event `org.sso.enforcement_changed` with `from`, `to`, `actor_id`, and `typed_confirm=true|false`. Also log `affected_count` when checklist runs.

rui: Accessibility QA: checklist: keyboard nav, screen reader live announcements, touch long-press, high-contrast focus ring, truncated role names include full text in `aria-label`. I'll write a 12-step spec and pilot with Accessibility Eng.

design-bot: design-assets: uploaded `invite/roles-hover-preview/v1` to Figma. :white_check_mark:

anya: Next steps:
- Rui: deliver ARIA + keyboard spec (Thu EOD)
- Devon: prototype touch long-press behavior (mobile)
- Sarah: finalize SSO modal copy and run legal check
- Ken: add telemetry events + audit fields to backlog
- Maya: mock sticky mini-preview for mobile in Figma

devon: ack :thumbsup:

rui: starting spec today :eyes:

sarah: pinging legal now

ken: adding tickets to backlog

anya: Thanks team  we'll test the anchored preview in a small lab with 6 participants next week and iterate based on overflow metrics. :sparkles:
